summary:
Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and related changes; nothing was run, so all test results are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: Task.finished_time field (after _get_time, before visible); Task.finished now means finished_time is not None; _reset clears finished_time; new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; update and advance capture elapsed as the last step inside the lock; reset clears finished_time before refresh.
- rich/default_styles.py: progress.elapsed styled yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ returns a Table (title, caption, three columns, 16 rows), with Color/Style/Table/Text imported inside the method and Table under TYPE_CHECKING.
- CHANGELOG.md: [Unreleased] / Added entry for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_progress.py: new test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn; test_columns expected output regenerated by hand trace.
- tests/test_palette.py: new test_rich_cast.

Unverified: test_columns expected output was derived by hand tracing clock reads (start frame elapsed 0:00:37 / 0:00:36; final frames 0:01:00 / 0:00:45; bars 33→25 and 23→16 cells; speeds now 1 byte/s). Grep confirmed the 12 rows have the new cell and no old-width bars remain in test_columns. I reasoned that test_track, test_progress_track, and test_render are unaffected, but did not verify this.
